title: SQLite Workload Lab
user: Developers shipping SQLite, FTS5, or SQLite extensions who need reproducible performance and CPU-compatibility evidence before publishing an optimization claim or binary release.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that executes declarative SQLite workloads in containers or QEMU profiles, captures SQLite version/compile options/PRAGMAs/query plans/CPU flags, and generates a diffable Markdown/JSON report.
success_measure: A release candidate is tested against at least three declared CPU profiles and a regression greater than 15% is detected from a committed baseline in CI.
constraints: Clearly separate emulator from hardware results.
Pin SQLite builds and fixture data.
Do not claim statistically significant improvements without repeated-run methodology.
